full_prompt_en: A square vintage storybook illustration shows people and animals crossing a pale wintry city street beneath tall dark buildings. The image is framed by a gray border and rendered mostly in ink-black, parchment cream, and restrained warm gray. On the left, a steep-roofed masonry block rises through the middle distance, its tower, chimneys, and narrow windows made from fine pen lines and shaded planes. Behind it, fainter spires and rooflines dissolve into a light mist. At the right, a dark wheeled carriage or early motor vehicle stands along the street, sending a thick twisting plume of black smoke upward to the top edge. The street slopes diagonally from the darker left foreground toward the brighter right. Across it, small silhouetted pedestrians walk in different directions, some accompanied by animals. Several animal forms run or bound through the middle, giving a loose lively motion to the scene. Bare branches spread across the left foreground and lower center, their thin lines partially overlaying the figures behind them. Dark clipped shadows fall to the lower right of the moving forms, tying them to the light ground. The ink treatment varies from dense black silhouettes in the foreground to delicate crosshatched architecture and almost blank distant atmosphere. Warm light seems to come from the open pale sky at upper right, brightening the road while leaving near buildings and branches dark. The smoke remains a strong vertical counterpoint to the sloped ground and many small moving marks. The overall composition is bustling yet airy, using crowded silhouettes, lively linework, and great pale spaces to turn an urban crossing into a whimsical printed tableau.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形旧书插图描绘人和动物穿过苍白冬日城市街道，上方耸着深色高楼。画面由灰色边框围住，主要以墨黑、羊皮纸奶油色和克制暖灰呈现。左侧一组陡屋顶砖石建筑立于中景，高塔、烟囱和狭窗由细钢笔线与阴影平面构成。其后更淡的尖塔和屋脊消失在浅雾中。右侧一辆深色带轮车厢或早期机动车停在街旁，浓厚弯曲的黑烟升至上缘。街道从较暗的左前景斜向较亮的右侧。小小行人剪影在其上往不同方向走，有些带着动物。几只动物形体在中部奔跑或跳跃，为场景带来松散活泼的运动。裸枝从左前景伸展到下方中央，细线部分叠在后方人物上。移动形体的深色截断阴影投向右下，把它们系在浅色地面上。墨线处理从前景浓黑剪影，变化为细密排线建筑和几乎空白的远方空气。暖光似乎来自右上方开阔浅天，照亮道路，近楼和树枝仍暗。烟柱与倾斜地面及众多小移动痕迹形成强烈的竖向对照。整体构图繁忙却通透，以拥挤剪影、活泼线条和大片浅色空间把城市交会变成俏皮的印刷式画面。
style_prompt_en: A vintage pen-and-ink illustration works with parchment cream, warm gray, and concentrated black rather than broad saturated color. Fine contours, crosshatching, and tiny architectural or surface marks build middle-distance detail, while closer forms simplify into lively dark silhouettes. The brightest open area remains relatively blank, giving the many small moving marks space to read. Contrast diminishes into misty distance; tall dark masses on one side balance a strong vertical accent elsewhere and a diagonal sweep below. Bare, branching linear structures can cross foreground space without closing it. Light comes from a pale open field, casting long clipped dark shadows across a light ground. The composition feels bustling and humorous but still airy, with varied line density and the slight roughness of old print giving it warmth.
style_prompt_zh: 复古钢笔墨线插画使用羊皮纸奶油色、暖灰与集中黑色，而非大片饱和颜色。细轮廓、交叉排线与小型结构或表面记号构成中景细节，近处形体则简化为活泼深色剪影。最明亮的开阔区域保持相对空白，让众多小运动痕迹有空间可读。反差向朦胧远处衰减；一侧高大深色量块平衡别处的强竖向重点及下方斜扫色带。裸枝般的线性结构可穿过前景而不封闭它。光从浅色开阔区域来，在浅地上投出细长截断的深影。构图繁忙幽默却仍通透，线条密度变化和旧印刷般的轻微粗糙带来暖意。
theme_en: People and animals crossing a pale wintry city street beneath a smoking carriage
theme_zh: 人和动物穿过苍白冬日城市街道，旁边车厢上方升起烟柱
name: Albert Dubout
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
